name: PATIENT_6
description: This table supplements the PATIENT table. It contains basic information about patients.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the patient record for this row. This column is frequently used to link to the PATIENT table.

columns.name: IMAGING_WILL_CALL_YN
columns.description: Holds a "Will Call" status for the patient. This is a status toggled by a Radiology user (eg. Technologist) to flag the availability of the patient for further processing.

columns.name: PAT_PRONOUN_FOR_USE_IN_TEXT_C_NAME
columns.description: The pronoun category ID for the patient which is used by the system for text generation.

columns.name: PAT_PRONOUN_COMMENT
columns.description: The pronoun comment or instructions entered by the user who documented a patient's pronouns.

columns.name: PAT_PRONOUN_OTHER_FREE_TEXT
columns.description: The free-text pronouns entered for a patient whose pronouns were not available to be discretely collected as a category value.

columns.name: PAT_PRONOUN_UPDATE_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time when the patient's pronouns were last updated, in UTC.

columns.name: SEX_FOR_MELD_C_NAME
columns.description: The patient's sex for adult Model for End-Stage Liver Disease (MELD) calculation.

columns.name: DEDUPLICATED_RCVD_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Deduplicated received document for this patient
